--- select_empty_block_comment.sql
SELECT 1 /**/ + 2 /* ordinary */

    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.ExprSelectItem{
        Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{

            ValuePos: 7,
            ValueEnd: 8,
            Base:     10,
            Value:    "1",
          },
          Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
            ValuePos: 16,
            ValueEnd: 17,
            Base:     10,
            Value:    "2",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT 1 + 2
